description: Elections Commission - D. K. S Perera of the Kesbewa Urban Council has Vacated his office of Members of the United National Party, K. D. S Jayarathna of the Seethawaka Pura Urban Council has Vacated his office of Members of the United National Party
reasoning: This gazette content contains a notice under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their offices as members of Urban Councils due to ceasing to be members of a political party. This directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials, falling under the Elections category (Type 7) which covers electoral matters including declarations about candidate status and office vacancies.
